data.title: 空门苍 · 壁橱里的闷热紧贴
data.description: 为了躲避巡查而挤进狭窄的壁橱内，两人的体温在逼仄的空间里急剧攀升。苍跨坐在膝头，衬衫完全湿透紧贴着饱满的胸脯，在近在咫尺的耳畔吐出温热的气息。
data.location: cramped cedar wood storage closet filled with folded spare blankets
data.action: straddling partner lap inside the enclosed closet, sweat-dampened shirt clinging transparently to skin, panting with dilated pupils and flushed cheeks
data.lighting: dim amber light slicing through closet door slats illuminating glistening sweat droplets
data.mood: steamy claustrophobic lust, intense breathless body heat, forbidden whispered ecstasy
data.promptProse: Straddling closely inside a cramped dark closet, Ao pants with a flushed face and parted lips, her sheer damp shirt sticking to her chest.
data.animaCaption: Ao straddling her partner in the cramped dark closet, breathless with heat.
